newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch forwarder opens Moscow office.
newsitem.headline: Dutch forwarder opens Moscow office.

text.p: Dutch forwarder, Winfo World Freight has opened an office in Moscow, a director of the Schiphol-based forwarder, Bert van der Velde said.
The branch named Winfo World Freight CIS will liaise with local forwarders and aims to increase the company's market share of the Russian market, he said.
van der Velde said the forwarder has considerable experience of the Russian market and he hopes that many problems will be eliminated by having someone on the ground.

The company provides logistics services for companies that are importing computers into Russia. It arranges for computer-related goods to be airfreighted into the Netherlands, where they are consolidated and before being trucked to Russia, he said.
Trucking is often easier than airfreighting to Russia because of the complicated customs procedures, he added.
The company is a member of the World Freight Group, a world-wide network of forwarders, established in 1992 in Singapore.
